Marta: AM async — quick handoff. What I did: finalized roadmap PR for route prioritization. Blockers: waiting on infra quota for dedicated canary (raised ticket IT-432). Today: sync with eng-runtime at 11:30, pair on rollout plan, review K8s manifest.
Ben: Did code review on https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/487 — left a comment on the fallback policy. No blockers. Today: implement batch size tuning and run perf job.
Kai: landed kv-cache optimization branch last night. Observed 8% p99 token latency improvement on staging. Blocker: need secrets to run full-suite loadtest (cc @Olivia).
Olivia: I can grant short-lived creds — pinged you in DM Kai. Also added prereq checklist for launch to the Confluence page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PRD/pages/12345. Today: prepping customer-facing notes and rollout timeline.
Chris: QA: found a flaky assertion in embedding tests — opened issue #319. Repro steps in the issue. Holding RC until that's triaged. Can someone take a look? @Ben maybe?
Ben: Looking now, should have a fix by EOD.
Marta: tiny ask — please add labels `launch-blocker`/`non-blocker` on issues so we can triage in the 11:30 sync. Also thumbs if you're good with the canary qps target: 250rps.
Kai: :thumbsup: 250rps ok from infra side.
Olivia: :+1: sounds good.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued for canary (canary-2026-03-17). Status: pending. Triggered by Marta.
Marta: thanks — adding rollout owners to the ticket. If anything blocks, drop a line here.
